records.name: Ill Flash
records.evidence: Dragon Ball Wiki's Xenoverse 2 section explicitly states that Ill Flash returns as one of Super Buu's Super Skills and that the Future Warrior can obtain it from the Skill Shop.

records.name: Spiral of Condemnation
records.evidence: The dedicated Xenoverse 2 page describes it as unique to Fused Zamasu (Half-Corrupted); the character page lists it in that exclusive preset, and an independent 2021 CaC-unobtainable list includes Spiral of Condemnation.
